name: University Entrance Examinations Benchmark
description: A dataset of university entrance exam questions used to evaluate NLP systems' problem-solving and reasoning abilities on real-world exam items.
evaluation_method: accuracy (for multiple-choice) and exact_match / rubric scoring for open-ended items
typical_sota_score: varies by exam and year (commonly from ~60% to >90% depending on task and model)
reputation: Widely used class of benchmarks for testing reasoning and problem-solving in NLP; commonly adopted in academic evaluations of model capabilities.
notes: Heterogeneous collection of real-world exam items; contamination risk from pretraining data is non-negligible, and difficulty varies across subjects and countries.
